A '''boddah''' was an employee of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who was assigned to run a [[Granee Noopa]] while his Hutt masters watched from far away. [[Venik Rin]] served as a boddah.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
